# netbox_cable_bundle (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/cablebundle/):

> This model allows grouping of cables which are physically bundled together, e.g. running through the same conduit or in the same cable tray.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_cable_bundle" "test" {
  name        = "bundle-a"
  description = "Cables running through conduit A"
  comments    = "Installed 2024-01-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `cable_count` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
